asset.name: Access granted
asset.description: Sent to the requester when the access has been provisioned.
asset.subject: Access granted: {{application}} ({{role}})
asset.html_body:
Your access is ready

Hi {{requester_name}},

{{user_name}} now has {{role}} access to {{application}} (grant {{grant_id}}, request {{request_reference}}).

Duration: {{duration}}. {{=IF(IS_EMPTY(expires_at), "Access stays until it is removed in an access review.", CONCAT("Access is removed automatically on ", FORMAT_DATE(expires_at, "DD/MM/YYYY"), "."))}}

Approved via: {{approval_path}}

Sent by your access request workflow
